name: The New Capenna train heist
description: A heist on a train in New Capenna, where Elnor fought off Brokers muscle, the beginning of the end for the crew.

timeline.summary: Yuma recalls the train heist and realizes that Elnor now fights like Shadress, meaning Shadress is dead.
